create.name: Angela Shelby
create.bio:
Angela Shelby is a certified Quantum-Touch practitioner, intuitive reader and dream interpreter living in Buckeye, Arizona, where she works under the name Enlightened Energy Works. Raised in Utah's Salt Lake Valley, she spent a decade as a children's nurse before a friend introduced her to energy work. Theta healing and then Quantum-Touch, in which she certified in 2018, opened the way to the wider intuitive work she does now.

Her Quantum-Touch sessions are gentle, light-touch or no-touch energy work, held in person or at a distance; she also describes channelling guidance during a session and passing on any messages afterwards, with a recording sent the same day. Alongside this she gives spirit-guide and mediumship readings by video or phone, and dream-interpretation sessions drawing on an interest she has followed since her teens. Her site also hosts a self-paced Spirit Guide Communication Course with short modules, exercises and a guided meditation for meeting a guide. She sees clients around Phoenix and works with people elsewhere online.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch energy sessions
courses.description: One-to-one Quantum-Touch sessions using light touch or no touch, in person near Phoenix or at a distance. Any guidance that comes through is shared at the end and sent as a recording the same day.

courses.title: Spirit guide and mediumship readings
courses.description: Readings of thirty or sixty minutes over Zoom or the phone, connecting with spirit guides or loved ones who have passed. The client sets the intention beforehand and says whom they hope to reach.

courses.title: Dream interpretation sessions
courses.description: Conversations about your dreams and what they may be saying, in person, by phone or online. A recording of the session is emailed afterwards.

courses.title: Spirit Guide Communication Course
courses.description: A self-paced course in short modules on who spirit guides are, how they may communicate and how to recognise their signs. It includes practice exercises and a guided meditation for meeting your guide.
